Subject: Finance forecast: RYG save-plan + commit confirmation for Orion Health

Patrick / Melissa —

Quick note as we close the month: finance needs a clean commit for forecast and your R/Y/G list so we can finalize the March projection. We reviewed the numbers in last week's call but two things moved and we need to capture them formally for the book:

- Net new start date slipped for the integration pilot from 4/5 to 4/26 (impacts revenue recognition in Q2).
- Procurement requested a revised payment schedule (they proposed net 60 instead of net 30).

Can you confirm the current commitment level (green = same, yellow = at-risk to close this quarter but likely, red = unlikely) per the three lines below? If you can, mark owners against each line so finance can map cash timing.

1) Pilot + integration services — $180k
2) Tiered seats (annual) — $420k
3) Professional services (training/customization) — $65k

I attached a short save-plan template and a snapshot of our current commit. If it's easier to 15-min call, I'm available Wed 3/11 9:00–11:00 PT.

Thanks —

Irene Choi
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: Orion_Health_SavePlan_v2.xlsx (xlsx), commit_snapshot_20260309.csv (csv)

Subject: Re: Finance forecast: RYG save-plan + commit confirmation for Orion Health

Irene —

Thanks for the clear template. Quick updates below — keeping it short so your finance team can land numbers: 

1) Pilot + integration services — $180k — YELLOW. Integration lead (Melissa) says deployment timeline bumped to late April; procurement is asking for a 30% holdback until integration acceptance. Owner: Melissa Chen (melissa.chen@orionhealth.com)

2) Tiered seats (annual) — $420k — GREEN. Legal cleared, PO forthcoming; billing contact confirmed. Owner: Accounts Payable (acct-finance@orionhealth.com)

3) Professional services (training/customization) — $65k — RED. Internal budget review deprioritized professional services for Q2; they asked if training could be scoped into the pilot instead. Owner: Patrick Hughes (patrick@orionhealth.com)

Action items from our side: we will try to 1) accelerate PO for seats, 2) confirm whether the holdback can be reduced to retention on acceptance (not entire 30%). I can push both, but procurement approval is the gating item — we expect an answer by Thu 3/12 EOD PT.

Thanks Patrick — useful clarity. I'm capturing this as a small save-plan and assigning owners/dates so finance can record locked vs. contingent: 

- Pilot + integration services ($180k) — Current: YELLOW. Save plan: agree acceptance criteria in writing; request a 50% PO release at start, 40% on acceptance, 10% retention. Owner: Melissa (deliverable: acceptance criteria doc). Due: 2026-03-18.
- Tiered seats ($420k) — Current: GREEN. Save plan: target PO arrival + invoice by 3/19 so revenue posts in March close. Owner: acct-finance@orionhealth.com (contact: AP team). Due: 2026-03-19.
- Professional services ($65k) — Current: RED. Save plan: offer to absorb 50% of training into pilot as a one-time concession; business to confirm if acceptable. Owner: Patrick. Due: 2026-03-12 (procurement decision).

I'll push to finance that we'll count seats as committed contingent on PO by 3/19. For pipeline hygiene: please update HubSpot stage to "Verbal Commit" for seats and add a custom field "SavePlanOwner" with the owner email.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
